exposure: number of previous cesarean sections (low-order: 1-2, high-order: 3+)
cohort: 1057 women undergoing repeat cesarean section at a single large obstetric center between January 1, 2021 and December 31, 2021.
finding: Spinal anesthesia was found to be safe and suitable for the majority of high-order repeat cesarean sections, except in cases with high suspicion of placental accreta spectrum.
